text_blocks.snippet: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) can cause a variety of side effects as the kidneys progressively lose their ability to filter waste and excess fluid from the blood. These side effects can range from mild to severe and may include fatigue, swelling, changes in urination, anemia, and high blood pressure. In advanced stages, CKD can lead to life-threatening complications like end-stage renal disease (ESRD).
